title: Saan manual scenario (one file per module)

module.description: module id = modules/<id>/module.json id = file name

title.description: Thai module name as the manual shows it

area.description: area of school work for the manual index (e.g. งานวิชาการ, งานบริหาร, เว็บไซต์โรงเรียน)

roles.description: who uses it, Thai, addressed by role

menu.description: where it is: menu path and URL; write [] semantics as the single string 'ไม่มีเมนู: ...' when it has no menu entry

workflows.description: workflow ids of that module that must be 'works' (optional; checked against results.json)

coverage.description: partial = the scenario covers only part of the module (say which in coverage_note); the verdict can then never be higher than ใช้ได้บางส่วน. Default full.

coverage_note.description: Thai: what the scenario covers and what it leaves out

untested.description: implemented features the author could not exercise with a browser (and why); printed in the manual and the audit as ยังไม่ได้ตรวจ

include_hidden.description: also match hidden elements (e.g. an input[type=file] that is visually hidden)

say.description: Thai instruction sentence shown in the manual; also the picture alt text

shot.description: take a picture after the step's effect is visible (needs say)

mask.description: extra elements blurred in the picture (password fields are always blurred)

wait_after.description: element that must be visible before the picture is taken

repeat_until.description: click step: click again (re-locating the target each time) until this element is visible, at most max times (default 6); for buttons that cycle through states

from_attr.description: capture: read this attribute (e.g. href) instead of the visible text

dialog.description: answer to a browser confirm()/alert() opened by this step (default accept)

dialog_text.description: text typed into a browser prompt() opened by this step before it is accepted (e.g. the reason asked when voiding); a list answers several prompts of the same step in order; {{marker}} and captured values work

secret.description: the typed value is secret: never stored in results

logins_ok.description: picture step on a page that lists account sign-in names beside a password label by design (user management): take the picture anyway. A visible account password is still refused.

optional.description: a failing step is recorded as a warning and the workflow goes on (use sparingly, e.g. an optional cookie banner)

kind.description: checked by content signature, not by name

contains.description: text that must occur in the file (text kinds)

role.description: key into the accounts file (homeroom, subject, editor, guardian1, student1, admin ...) or 'anonymous'

start.description: URL path (or absolute http URL) opened after sign-in; the manual prints it as 'เริ่มจากหน้า'

cleanup.description: undoes the data the other workflows of the module created; always runs last in its module and is never blocked by failures of the others

core.description: this workflow is the module's main task; if it does not work the verdict is 'มีแต่โครง'

depends_on.description: workflow ids (same module) or module.workflow; the runner runs them first and marks this one blocked when they do not work

expected.description: Thai text for 'ผลที่ควรเห็น'

as.description: another role: opens a fresh browser context signed in as it

promised.description: what the UI, menu or module.json promises

evidence.description: how it was seen: file:line read, screen clicked, picture path, route list

confirm_how.description: required when confirmed is false: what would confirm it (the manual prints 'ยังไม่ได้ยืนยัน')
